connectionSpecification.description: Reads HubSpot CRM objects, custom objects, owners, pipelines and associations with a private app access token.

access_token.description: Access token of a HubSpot private app (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps) with the read scopes of the streams to sync. It is sent in the Authorization header.
access_token.title: Private App Access Token

start_date.description: Earliest last modification the first incremental sync of CRM objects reads: an RFC 3339 time or YYYY-MM-DD, in UTC. Empty reads everything.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: HubSpot Source Spec
